schemaFunctions.$comment: On File Change TEMPLATE — repeatable:true (one instance per content format). The content parameter is kind=VARIANT: selecting a format swaps the whole content sub-form and the emitted handler name. The SMB listener auto-routes files to the matching handler by file extension (.txt->onFileText, .json->onFileJson, .xml->onFileXml, .csv->onFileCsv, other->onFile); @smb:FunctionConfig can override the routing pattern per handler. fileInfo is always present (not optional, unlike FTP); caller is optional.
